sections.label: Law opposes suicide, prosecutions rare
sections.summary: It was thought important that society signal through law its opposition to people taking their own lives, but prosecutions are rare in practice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: On behalf of Ms Kuik, Question No 23.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: It was thought to be important that society should signal through the law that it opposes people taking their own lives but, in practice, prosecutions are rare.

sections.label: Police handcuff use on arrest
sections.summary: When an arrest is made, Police Officers use handcuffs when assessed as needed for safety, preventing self-harm, harm to others, or absconding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: When an arrest is made, Police Officers use handcuffs when the assessment is that there is a need to ensure the safety of the person, prevent the person from further self-harm, prevent the person from causing harm to escorting officers or members of the public in the vicinity, or to prevent the person from absconding.

sections.label: Prosecutions and imprisonment for attempted suicide
sections.summary: In 2015 two persons were prosecuted for attempting suicide out of 1,096 reported cases, and five charged persons were imprisoned over 2011 to 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2015, two persons were prosecuted for attempting suicide, out of 1,096 reported cases of attempted suicide.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the five years over 2011 to 2015, five persons who were charged for attempted suicide were imprisoned.

sections.label: Public education and suicide prevention hotline
sections.summary: It undertakes regular public education on suicides and available help, runs a 24-hour crisis intervention and suicide prevention hotline, as a whole-of-community, whole-of-Government effort.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State, can you keep your reply short.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It undertakes regular public education efforts to raise public understanding of suicides and available avenues for help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It also runs a 24-hour crisis intervention and suicide prevention hotline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, all in, it is a whole-of-community, whole-of-Government effort.
